lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: # Contributing

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Develop

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: This repo uses [Vite+](https://viteplus.dev/). Install the global `vp` command once:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ```sh

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: curl -fsSL https://vite.plus | bash

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: On Windows, run `irm https://vite.plus/ps1 | iex`. See the [Vite+ guide](https://viteplus.dev/guide/) for more.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: T3 Code worktrees need `vp` too. `t3.json` runs `node scripts/setup-worktree.ts` for each new worktree, and that script installs dependencies with `vp i`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: `pnpm build` writes `dist/cli` and `dist/ui`. `prepack` runs the build, so `pnpm pack` and `pnpm publish` always ship the UI.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: `pnpm sync:skill` copies the JSON Schema into `skills-next/comprehende/`, pins `npx comprehende@<version>` there, and copies that tree to `.agents/skills/comprehende`. Agents in this checkout then use the next skill. It does not touch `skills/comprehende/`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: `pnpm dev` and `pnpm exec` run with this package as cwd, so they review this repo only. To review another project from a checkout, `cd` into it and run `node /path/to/comprehende/dist/cli/main.js` after `pnpm build`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: To use the next skill with the local CLI in any folder, install this checkout as the global skill:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ```sh

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: pnpm dev:skill

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: It builds, copies `skills-next/comprehende/` to `~/.agents/skills/comprehende/`, and points the CLI pin at `node <checkout>/dist/cli/main.js`. Run it again after each rebuild, and after `npx skills update`, which restores the published skill.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Serve and export

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: `serve` and `export` share one UI and one git payload. `serve` resolves the refs to commit SHAs at start, then builds the payloads from those objects on each request. `export` writes the same JSON and image bytes next to the UI.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: This repository publishes exports to GitHub Pages. A pull request review is at `https://matemolnar8.github.io/comprehende/pr/<number>/`, and a named site is at `https://matemolnar8.github.io/comprehende/site/<name>/`. To enable Pages, open the repo's Settings > Pages, choose Deploy from a branch, branch `gh-pages`, folder `/`. A workflow deletes a pull request's folder when the pull request closes, and deletes sites older than 30 days.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Refresh

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: `review` and `pregroup` record the commits the refs resolved to in `source.baseSha` and `source.headSha`. `refresh` resolves the refs again and then:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - keeps each hunk whose path and changed lines did not change, and moves its ref when only the start line moved

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - keeps an edited hunk in its group and marks it changed, or reformat when only whitespace moved

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - drops refs whose hunk left the diff

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - puts hunks that no group covers into a draft `update` group

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: It prints the new commit subjects and one line per changed file, so the skill rewrites only the groups that changed. `serve` and `export` print a note when the refs no longer resolve to the recorded commits.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Release

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Edit the skill in `skills-next/comprehende/`. `npx skills add` reads `skills/comprehende/` only.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Bump `version` in `package.json` when the CLI or UI changes, then run `pnpm sync:skill` so the next skill pin matches. Pre-commit and `pnpm test` fail if the staged package version and the next skill pin differ. Do not bump for skill-only edits. Use the number the user names. If they name none, use the next semver: patch for fixes, minor for new features, major for breaking changes.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: When the next skill should ship with `npx skills add`, run `pnpm release:skill`. It copies `skills-next/comprehende/` onto `skills/comprehende/`. Run it in the same change that publishes a new CLI, so `npx skills add` installs instructions that match the package they pin.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Push to `main`. CI packs and tests the tarball on every change, and publishes the version if npm does not have it yet. Skill-only commits keep the same version, so they do not publish.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The first publish was manual (`pnpm publish --access public`) to claim the name. Later publishes use a GitHub Actions trusted publisher on npmjs.com for workflow `ci.yml`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Fixture

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ```sh

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: pnpm fixture

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: cd fixtures/repo

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: node ../../dist/cli/main.js serve --data ../example/review.json

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: `pnpm fixture` writes a small git repo to `fixtures/repo` (gitignored) and a refs-only `fixtures/example/review.json` with stories, lookFor, and sources. Run `serve` or `export` with cwd set to `fixtures/repo`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: To export a static copy from the same cwd:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ```sh

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: node ../../dist/cli/main.js export --data ../example/review.json --out ../../fixtures/site

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The folder holds the UI, frozen `api/*.json` payloads, and image bytes, with no git. Any static file server can host it:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ```sh

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: python3 -m http.server --directory ../../fixtures/site 8080
